app_caption: Vehicle counts, speed, and direction from traffic video. No plates, no identity data, no registration lookups.
text_try_on_device: 📷 Just want to try it with your own camera, right now? Use the on-device page →
text_try_new_dashboard: 📊 Want the polished, chart-based view of your results? Open the new dashboard page →
caption_calibration: Speed needs calibration: two points a known real-world distance apart.
info_add_camera: Add a camera in the sidebar to see the dashboard.
warning_no_vehicles: No vehicles were tracked in the videos added so far.
caption_no_speed_data: No calibrated speed data in these videos yet.
caption_location: Optional: country and coordinates, to show public road-safety reference data for this location.
label_country_code: Country code (2 letters, e.g. IN, US)
text_no_country_data: No global road-safety reference data found for this country.
text_speed_limit_unknown: No posted speed limit found on OpenStreetMap near this location.
text_context_disclaimer: Reference data for the country/road, not a prediction for this specific camera.
text_weather: Weather during recording: {temp}°C, {precip} mm precipitation, {wind} km/h wind
text_weather_unavailable: No weather data available for this time and location yet.
caption_weather_sample_too_small: Not enough hours with varying weather yet to say whether there's a real pattern here — this is just what was measured, side by side.
text_percent_over_limit: {percent}% of hours averaged above the posted limit ({avg} km/h measured vs. {limit} km/h posted)
text_no_risk_score: This is not a crash-risk score — that would need real historical crash data for this exact road, which isn't available yet. These are just the measured facts, side by side.
caption_us_county_fips: US cameras only: look up your county's 5-digit FIPS code online (2-digit state + 3-digit county) to see fatal-crash counts on file for that county.
text_county_crashes: NHTSA FARS: {count} fatal crashes on file for this county in {year}
text_county_crashes_unavailable: No fatal-crash data available for this county/year yet.
expander_live_camera: 📹 Live camera (beta) — see counts from your own camera right now
caption_live_camera: Runs the same detector used for uploaded videos, against your browser's camera, live. Nothing is recorded or saved — it only exists while this is open. This free hosting tier is a shared CPU with no GPU, so expect a few frames per second rather than smooth video; the on-device page is the smooth, truly real-time option. While the camera is running, other controls on this page won't respond until you stop it.
caption_live_network_note: Needs camera permission, and works best on Wi-Fi: this free setup can't always get through mobile-carrier networks. If "Start" doesn't connect after a few seconds, try a Wi-Fi connection instead.
warning_live_camera_unavailable: Live camera isn't available on this deployment right now (a required package didn't load). Uploading a video above still works normally.
caption_export_results: Download everything shown on this page as one JSON file. Use it with the standalone dashboard page for a richer, chart-based view of these results.
